text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa hails Kuwait's policies and bilateral relations.
- Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah on Monday met at his London residence with some Arab ambassadors.
- Minister of Social Affairs and Labour Ahmad al-Kulaib says new labour law to be implemented next October.
- Lebanon signs a 10 million dinar ($33 million) loan accord with Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development.
- World Health Organisation (WHO) says Kuwait free from polio.
- Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah rejects bill to shift farms from the northern border with Iraq.
- Kuwaiti woman acquitted of killing her three-year-old daughter.
